title: Apple issues Meltdown and Spectre patches for older versions of its Mac operating system - and you should install them right away (AAPL, INTC)
text: Apple issues Meltdown and Spectre patches for older versions of its Mac operating system — and you should install them right away (AAPL, INTC) By Antonio Villas-Boas Jan 23, 2018, 4:44 pm 14 pts Apple released new updates for older versions of its Mac operating system to protect against the Meltdown and Spectre attacks. The company had previously issued a patch for macOS High Sierra, the most recent version of its Mac operating system, but it put out a new update for High Sierra also. The…
